About

Rooted in craft,
driven by intention

Hello — I'm Trinity. A visual artist and creative director based in Port Harcourt, Rivers State, with over a decade of experience translating ideas into compelling works of art.

My work spans paintings, pencil drawings, digital art, and graphic design — precise enough for brands, soulful enough to endure. I believe every piece should tell a story that outlasts the moment it was made.

I work closely with a small roster of clients each year to ensure every project receives the depth of attention it deserves.

How I Work

A simple, transparent process

01

Consultation

We begin with a conversation — understanding your vision, purpose, and what the piece means to you.

02

Concept

I develop sketches, mood boards, and a creative direction for your approval before a single stroke is made.

03

Creation

The work comes to life. I share progress updates so you feel connected to the piece every step of the way.

04

Delivery

Your finished piece is packaged with care and delivered — physically or digitally — ready to be displayed or published.
